item.title: My Attempt at Building a Multi-GPU Embedding Server with TEI and Qdrant
item.description: GitHub repo: https://github.com/joe32140/tei-qdrant-cache Before We Start Serving an LLM-based embedding model with replicas across multiple GPUs on the same machine might sound trivial today (2025), but after my extensive search, there’s actually no one-click setup. Originally, I thought vLLM could easily fulfill my needs, or that SGLang could be an alternative if vLLM didn’t work. However, both libraries turned out to be either limited to specific models or unable to route requests across multiple GPUs.

item.title: Reproducibility Report of ModernBERT Models for Retrieval Tasks Using DPR
item.description: Cross-posted here: https://api.wandb.ai/links/joe32140/zqs87nz3 Before We Start As researchers from LightOn.AI and Answer.AI released the ModernBERT models, a BERT redesigned for 2024, I was interested to see its performance on retrieval tasks as mentioned in their paper, specifically with DPR. However, they had not released the model checkpoints for all experiments. I decided to fine-tune ModernBERT on the MS MARCO dataset by myself based on the provided training scripts.
